storyCards.headline: Johnny Can't Read: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Don Henley's "Johnny Can't Read" reached #42 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #42 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 11 weeks on the chart.

Johnny Can't Read was released in 1982.
